description: Get the FULL TEXT of a US court opinion by its CourtListener opinion ID (the opinion_id returned by search_opinions). Covers 8.3 million opinions, 71% state case law — no API key needed. Returns the opinion text, the case name, the real filing date, author, citation count, whether the text came from OCR of a scan, and the data as-of date. Opinions filed after that date may fall through to live search.
name: get_opinion
